description: 贝壳褶环绕大帽檐、凉感针织、可舒展可卷收的双用遮阳帽长图组

styleLock.direction: airy summer sun-shade accessory commerce built on a sand-and-sky field
styleLock.backgroundSystem: 下半细沙米平面 #E0D2BC、上半无缝晴空蓝场 #9CC2E0 的沙天系统，与信息屏的无缝纯白平面 #FFFFFF 交替使用；单一层、浅景深、无杂物、无渐变彩条
styleLock.lightingSystem: 户外感大号柔光左前主光 5600-5800K + 白色反光板补光，自上而下柔和衰减，接触阴影真实落地；微距与结构镜加一条左向掠射光凸显褶皱起伏，禁止硬边与矛盾光向
styleLock.surfaceSystem: 细密凉感针织面、放射状褶皱壳面、滚条包边、内侧吸汗针织带、一枚压制金属小饰件；台面为干燥细沙 #E0D2BC 或哑光纯白 #FFFFFF
styleLock.typography: 现代几何无衬线单一字族，顶部一条标题带加两至四枚圆角细线图标卡，引线标签 12pt，扁平无投影；禁手写体、复古体、彩虹渐变分隔线
styleLock.iconSystem: 1.5pt 单色描边扁平象形图标，等线宽，置于圆角卡底 #FFFFFF 上，强调线用 #9CC2E0，无立体、无填充、无渐变
styleLock.presentationRules: 产品按真实比例稳定呈现，放射褶皱壳形与环绕帽檐轮廓完整不裁切；出现佩戴者只用背影、后侧 45 度、下颌以下裁切或侧影，画面内不出现可识别面部；一切数值、等级与资质文字一律占位，不渲染数字
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent airy summer sun-shade accessory visual system across the whole set; fixed palette of studio white #FFFFFF, fine sand surface #E0D2BC, deep charcoal type #2D2D2D, one clear-sky accent #9CC2E0 and one soft butter-yellow secondary #F0CE79, with the product's own color taken from the reference; cool high-key tone throughout; modern geometric sans-serif only, thin single-color rules, no rainbow gradients, no script or retro lettering; background system alternating a fine-sand and clear-sky field with a seamless studio white plane, one clean layer, shallow depth, no gradient stripes; lighting system of outdoor-feel large soft front-left key at 5600-5800K with white bounce fill, gentle top-to-bottom falloff, true grounded contact shadows, plus one raking light on macro and structure frames, never hard or contradictory; surface language of fine cool-touch technical knit, radially pleated shell face, bound piping edge, brushed inner headband and one pressed metal ornament; layout system of one headline band across the top, two to four rounded thin-line icon cards, hairline leader labels, generous margins, flat type with no drop shadow; icon system of 1.5pt single-color outline pictograms with equal stroke weight, flat, no 3D, no fill; product shown at stable real-world scale with the pleated shell brim complete and never clipped, and any wearer shown only as back view, cropped profile below the jaw or hands so no face is identifiable; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no invented figures or ratings, no readable brand marks.

shots.intent: 搜索首图一眼看清放射褶皱壳形与环绕帽檐的独有轮廓，先抢点击。
shots.camera: 正面 3/4（约 20 度侧偏）、平视、全景；主件立起，另两件侧卧成组，轮廓完整不裁切
shots.lighting: 户外感大号柔光左前上方 5600K + 白色反光板补光，接触阴影落在沙面
shots.background: 下半细沙米平面 #E0D2BC，上半无缝晴空蓝场 #9CC2E0，一条干净地平线
shots.promptTemplate: Packshot product photography of {product}, several colorways of the same piece grouped as one composition. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Purpose: win the search click by showing the radially pleated shell brim and the open crown band at a glance. Centered front 3/4 view at eye level, the lead unit standing upright and the other units resting on their sides, every piece fully visible and unclipped. Bright outdoor-feel high-key light, large soft key from the upper left around 5600K with white bounce fill on the shadow side, true soft contact shadows where each piece meets the sand. Lower band is fine dry sand #E0D2BC, upper band is a seamless clear-sky field #9CC2E0, one clean horizon line. No other props. Product group occupies 60-70% of the frame. No in-image text. Square 1:1, 2K commercial e-commerce quality. Negative: no watermark, no stock-site marks, no person, no face, no hands, no fake logo, no added lettering, no decorative elements, no gradient stripes, no cut-off edges, no floating pieces without contact shadow, no duplicated panel inside one unit.

shots.background: 无缝晴空蓝场 #9CC2E0，底部一条细沙米平面 #E0D2BC
shots.whitespace: 顶部保留一条干净标题带
shots.textZone: 上四分之一居中一行主标，其下并排两枚圆角细线图标标签
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce benefit hero of {product} worn by a wearer seen from behind. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Purpose: state the one-second reason to buy, wide coverage of face line and nape, without naming any measured figure. Photographed from behind at a 45-degree rear angle, camera slightly low, showing only the back of the head, nape and shoulder line so no face enters the frame; the pleated brim arches open around the crown band and its shadow falls as one clean band across the neck. Large soft key from front-left around 5800K with cool fill, shadow direction consistent with the light. Seamless clear-sky field #9CC2E0 behind and a narrow band of fine sand #E0D2BC at the base. No props. Product occupies 50-60% of the frame. Text zone: one headline band across the top quarter in #2D2D2D at 32pt reading 「{selling_point_1}」, plus two rounded thin-line icon callouts beneath it reading 「{callout_1}」 and 「{callout_2}」 in #2D2D2D at 12pt; every value is a placeholder. Negative: no visible face, no eye contact, no invented percentages or protection ratings, no sun badge with numbers, no garbled characters, no dense body text, no rainbow gradient divider, no watermark, no fake logo.

shots.intent: 先让买家认领正午直射下额面与颈后的真实暴晒感，再给出方案。

shots.background: 晒白的细沙米平面 #E0D2BC 铺满画面，顶部一条窄过曝晴空蓝场 #9CC2E0
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce pain-point documentary frame with {product} appearing as the resolution moment. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Purpose: make the buyer recognise hard midday exposure along the forehead line, cheeks and nape before the product answers it. Eye-level long-lens view from behind, figure cropped above the shoulders with the top of the head cut by the frame so no face is visible; the piece sits low in the right third, brim catching the light. Harsh overhead midday sun, blown-out highlights, faint heat shimmer above the surface, shadows falling straight down and matching the sun position. Bleached fine sand field #E0D2BC fills the frame with one narrow overexposed clear-sky band #9CC2E0 at the top. No props. Product occupies 30-40% of the frame and stays readable in silhouette. No in-image text. Vertical 3:4, 2K. Negative: no visible face, no facial features, no eye contact, no deformed hands, no duplicated background people, no contradictory shadow directions, no over-smoothed plastic skin, no watermark, no fake logo, no text.

shots.intent: 用真实出行侧影完成自我代入，让褶皱壳形在日光里被看清。
shots.camera: 干净 90 度正侧面、机位略低，人物裁切在下颌以下，只到颈与肩线
shots.lighting: 开阔阴影日光约 6500K，背后一条微弱轮廓光，投影方向与太阳位置一致
shots.background: 浅色天空 #9CC2E0 与虚化的沙岸地平线，脚下细沙米 #E0D2BC
shots.promptTemplate: Lifestyle scene photography of {product} worn on a summer shoreline. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Purpose: self-projection into a believable warm-season outing. Photographed from a clean 90-degree side profile at a slightly low angle, the wearer cropped below the jaw so only the neck, collarbone and shoulder line read; the pleated shell arch frames the profile and throws a soft band of shade toward the neck. Open-shade daylight around 6500K with a faint warm rim from behind, all shadows consistent with the sun. Pale sky #9CC2E0 behind, fine sand #E0D2BC underfoot, background gently out of focus. No props. Product occupies 40-50% of the frame and stays the clear subject. No in-image text. Portrait 2:3, 2K. Negative: no visible face, no eyes or teeth, no distorted jawline, no over-smoothed plastic skin, no recognizable person, no contradictory shadow direction, no duplicated wave or sand texture, no watermark, no fake logo, no text.

shots.intent: 用织纹与内侧织带的真实质感替代一切口头材质主张。
shots.camera: 极近微距、约 70 度俯角掠射，浅景深 f/3.2，最近纱线清晰、远端虚化
shots.lighting: 左侧低角度掠射光凸显经纬起伏，高光可控不过曝
shots.background: 织面本身铺满画面，右上角露一条晴空蓝场 #9CC2E0
shots.promptTemplate: Extreme close-up macro photography of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Purpose: prove the material by showing it instead of describing it. Tight zoom on the fine technical knit face where it meets the brushed inner headband, shot from above at about a 70-degree grazing angle, shallow depth of field at f/3.2 with the nearest yarn loops crisp and the far edge soft. Low raking side light from the left revealing yarn relief and stitch rows, controlled satin highlight, no blown specular. The material fills the frame with one narrow strip of clear-sky field #9CC2E0 at the upper right corner. No props. Detail occupies 55-60% of the frame. No in-image text. Square 1:1, 4K macro quality. Negative: no blurry subject, no plastic-looking sheen, no repeating tiled texture, no lint artifacts, no invented fiber cross-section diagram, no watermark, no fake logo, no text overlay.

shots.intent: 把外层曲面与内层异质面朝同一道包边的结构关系讲清，让人看懂机制。
shots.camera: 极低角度仰视约 15 度，局部特写，前景为同一道包边上翻折出的两层朝面
shots.lighting: 柔光自右上入射，沿包边走一条可控高光，其余保持哑光
shots.background: 无缝晴空蓝场 #9CC2E0，单层干净、轻微衰减
shots.textZone: 右侧两条细引线标签位
shots.promptTemplate: Close-up detail photography of {product}, construction and layer study. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Purpose: let the buyer read how the shaped outer face and the contrasting inner face work along one edge instead of trusting a claim. Photographed from a very low angle looking upward at about 15 degrees so the matte outer face and the smoother inner face both catch light along the same bound brim edge, with three thin hairline ray lines skipping off the outer face and stopping at the edge. Soft key from upper right with one controlled highlight along the piping, everything else matte. Seamless clear-sky field #9CC2E0, one clean plane. No props. Detail occupies 55-60% of the frame. Text zone: two thin leader-line labels at the right margin reading 「{callout_1}」 and 「{callout_2}」 in #2D2D2D at 12pt. Vertical 3:4, 2K. Negative: no invented percentages, no wavelength or rating figures, no blueprint grid, no extra panels or seams that are not on the product, no distorted edge lines, no face, no hands, no watermark, no fake logo.

shots.intent: 把轻感做成看得见的平衡关系，而不是一个数字。
shots.camera: 平视略 3/4，全景；托盘、支点与两侧物件全部入画并落在同一台面
shots.lighting: 大面积柔光左前主光 + 白色补光，两只托盘的接触阴影长度一致

shots.props: 一只无字细身天平架与一只无印刷日常纸巾盒，仅此两件
shots.textZone: 天平架下方一行短标签位
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce comparison screen of {product} set against one everyday reference object. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Purpose: make lightness legible as a balanced scene rather than as a figure. Photographed at eye level from a slight 3/4 angle: a slim unprinted balance stand with the piece resting on one pan and one small everyday unprinted paper tissue box on the other, both pans, the beam and both items fully visible and grounded, the beam reading near level. Large soft front-left key with white bounce fill, matched short contact shadows beneath the stand feet. Fine sand foreground plane #E0D2BC meeting a seamless clear-sky field #9CC2E0 behind. Props: one blank balance stand and one unprinted tissue box only. Scene occupies 45-50% of the frame. Text zone: one short label under the stand reading 「{callout_1}」 in #2D2D2D at 14pt, with no digits rendered. Vertical 3:4, 2K. Negative: no weight figures, no gram or ounce units, no fabricated measurement, no floating items, no mismatched shadow lengths, no brand marks on the box, no face, no hands, no watermark, no fake logo.

shots.intent: 用引线和一个中性比例锚点解决檐有多宽、头围怎么调的疑虑。

shots.lighting: 均匀平光、几乎无影，保证引线与标签可读
shots.props: 一张无字哑光纸卡做比例锚点
shots.textZone: 产品四周两枚引线标签，右侧三行短规格标签
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce infographic spec screen of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Purpose: remove doubt about how far the brim reaches and how the fit is adjusted. Photographed from a high 45-degree angle looking down, the piece laid with its circular brim fully spread so the wrap-around arc reads, one hairline dimension line drawn across the brim width and a second short line marking the rear adjustment closure, plus one blank matte paper card beside it as a neutral scale anchor. Flat even shadowless light so leader lines and labels stay readable. Seamless studio field #FFFFFF. Product occupies 45-50% of the frame, left of centre. Text zone: two leader labels reading 「{callout_1}」 and 「{callout_2}」 in #9CC2E0 at 12pt, and a right-hand column of three short spec rows reading 「{callout_3}」, 「{callout_4}」 and 「{callout_5}」 in #2D2D2D at 12pt; all measurements stay placeholders. Vertical 3:4, 2K. Negative: no invented measurements, no numeric units, no fake technical drawing dimensions, no dense body text, no garbled characters, no face, no hands, no watermark, no fake logo.

shots.intent: 同一件摆出舒展与卷收两种形态并附色卡，让买家一眼完成决策。
shots.camera: 正上方 90 度俯视平铺，上下两行同角度同比例，右侧一列色卡
shots.lighting: 大面积柔光顶光，每件接触阴影一致，无反光漂移
shots.textZone: 每行右侧一枚短标签与一行色卡小方块
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce variant and dual-use flat-lay of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Purpose: show the same piece in both wearing states and in its colorways so the buyer decides in one look. Photographed directly from above at a 90-degree overhead angle: the upper row shows the brim fully spread in its pleated shell shape, the lower row shows the same piece gathered and rolled into a band ring with its closure ends facing up, and one column of small colorway chips runs along the right; every unit at identical scale, identical orientation logic and identical light. Large soft top light, matching contact shadow under each unit, no reflection drift. Seamless clear-sky field #9CC2E0. No props. Units occupy 60-70% overall. Text zone: one short label beside each row reading 「{callout_1}」 and 「{callout_2}」 in #2D2D2D at 12pt, plus one small square swatch chip per colorway with its color hex-pinned from the reference or from {accent_color}. Square 1:1, 2K. Negative: no mixed lighting between units, no size drift, no invented extra parts, no repeated unit that fails to change state, no face, no hands, no watermark, no fake logo, no dense body text.

shots.intent: 以三格可核验做工细节收口长图，用真实工艺替代表章与报告画面。
shots.camera: 三格同距同裁切纵向排布，每格均正对平视特写：顶饰件、放射褶皱走线、内侧织带与后部扣合
shots.lighting: 柔光左前主光 + 白色补光，仅金属件上一条可控高光，其余哑光
shots.background: 无缝纯白平面 #FFFFFF，右侧立一张无字空白卡板作文档位

shots.whitespace: 底部保留一条窄留白带
shots.textZone: 每格右侧一枚短标签，底部一行收口标题
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce trust and craftsmanship screen of {product}, three matched detail panels on one card. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Purpose: close the detail page on verifiable making quality rather than on badges. Three crops stacked in one column, each photographed straight-on at the same distance and crop: the top crop on the pressed metal ornament set into the crown band, the middle crop on a row of radial pleats with its stitch line running evenly, the lower crop on the inner absorbent headband and the rear closure; identical framing and identical light across all three, every part resting with its own soft contact shadow. Soft front-left key with white bounce fill, one controlled highlight streak on the metal piece only, everything else matte. Seamless studio field #FFFFFF with one blank unprinted card panel standing at the right as an empty documentation slot. Props: that blank card panel only. Panels occupy 55-65% overall. Text zone: one short label beside each crop reading 「{callout_1}」, 「{callout_2}」 and 「{callout_3}」 in #2D2D2D at 12pt, and one closing line at the bottom reading 「{selling_point_2}」 in #2D2D2D at 24pt. Vertical 3:4, 2K. Negative: no certificates, no lab reports, no serial numbers, no QR codes, no website or contact lines, no store or membership badges, no invented warranty claims, no loose threads faked as damage, no face, no hands, no watermark, no fake logo.

provenance.notes: 源为 1 张详情页长图的 12 片切片（沙天三色开场、四宫格特点图标、凉感纤维立体示意、检测报告空位、双层阻隔结构仰视、环绕檐主张、12CM 引线、天平称重对比、内侧织带微距与圆形放大窗、展檐与卷收双形态、细节展示三格说明）。已剥离：源图右上角图库水印与站点标识、左下角会员角标与二维码、原文全部中文标题与正文（一帽两用、全脸防晒模式、凉感科技系列、专业第三方检测机构检测报告、轻若无感、云感纤维工艺说明、细节说明行等）、报告页与三格细节位的空白占位框，以及出现的全部数值（防晒等级与透射率百分比、降温度数、帽檐厘米数、360 度环形数）一律改为 {selling_point_*} / {callout_*} 占位，画面内不渲染任何数字或资质图形。品类判定：源夹前缀「百货」不在 taxonomy 的 24 个 L1 之内，属来源批次标签而非品类，故以图主体判定；主体为女士头部佩戴的凉感针织褶皱壳形遮阳帽（头饰配饰），taxonomy 中女装无配饰层级，故取 L1 珠宝饰品 / L2 配饰（库内唯一可容纳帽饰的层级），与库内三件既有帽饰同挂一处；若下游需按户外功能检索，可另挂运动户外 / 服饰的相似映射，本模版不双写。差异化：与 女士空顶大檐遮阳帽（平顶硬挺大檐、雾蓝加柔粉底色、山径徒步与收纳包装收口）不同，本款为放射褶皱贝壳壳形、内层异质朝面、可舒展成超大檐亦可卷收为环带的两用结构，视觉体系改为细沙米 #E0D2BC 加晴空蓝 #9CC2E0 加奶油黄 #F0CE79 的沙天场与天平轻感、双层结构仰视、双形态俯视三套独有构图；与 钩针编织盆帽（棉线钩织镂空盆形）和 棉质宽檐渔夫帽（棉布深顶宽檐渔夫形）在帽型（空顶环带无顶、壳形褶皱）、材质（细密凉感针织加吸汗织带与压制金属件）、功能（全周遮蔽与形态可切换）、色系（沙天蓝黄四色、无棉麻大地色）四个维度均不重叠。displayName 与 id 已逐字比对库内既有帽饰条目，无冲突。
